output.subject: Your question about settling your former credit card account
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for getting in touch, and for taking this step. We appreciate you reaching out to resolve this.

You told us that your old credit card with us was charged off in 2023, and that you are now in a position to settle it. You asked two things: who you should speak with about a settlement, and whether you can get the settlement terms in writing before you make any payment.

Your message has been passed to the appropriate team, who will respond to your questions within 10 business days, including who you should contact and your request to have the terms in writing before paying.

In the meantime, if anything about your circumstances changes or you have further questions, please reply to this message.

Thank you again for reaching out. We look forward to responding to your questions.

Kind regards,

Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Inquiry, not a complaint: customer wants to settle a credit card charged off in 2023.
Confirm whether the bank still owns the debt or whether it was sold or placed with a third-party collector; if so, tell the customer who to contact.
Decide whether written settlement terms can be provided before payment and say so explicitly in the reply.
Add the correct contact point and method for settlement discussions.
The reply refers only to 'the appropriate team'; decide whether to name the team before sending.
Do not confirm any settlement amount or credit-reporting outcome until the account has been reviewed.
